body: Coordinator slip (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-11 09:08Z, my own miss). I issued a termal_send_to_session whose body was only "placeholder" to host:e83d08f4…::session-4 (the DL560 Engram Runner) in the same parallel batch as a real reply. It was durably delivered as relay #166. I corrected it at once with #167 ("please IGNORE #166"). Rule: never issue a send as a placeholder or no-op, even when it seems harmless. Every send is durable and wakes a real agent. Decide the exact recipient and body before issuing it. For a relay sender, reply to the exact host-qualified native session that wrote the message (here the Mac runner host:abf8bda6…::session-6201), not to another runner with a similar name.
